note:
Alice — SR/Fire (NOT `alice-wonderland-bunny`, SMG/Water). Board: 1.101 HOT on her single graded comp, PA MiKa (anis-star + mint + prika + alice + red-hood). Kit-faithfulness is verified by event-log spec in scripts/tests/units/alice.test.ts.
MODEL — 5 load-bearing lines. S1 = fullBurstEnter → the 2 highest-final-ATK allies get chargeSpeedPct 11.67 + chargeDamagePct 7, 10s. S2 = 'Gain continuous Pierce' → top-level hasPierce. BURST = burstCast → self chargeSpeedPct 80.15 + atkPct 55.12, 10s.
HER PIERCE TAG IS NOT INERT — IT IS WORTH ~+23% OF HER DAMAGE ON HER GRADED COMP, AND IT IS THE BULK OF HER HOT READ. `hasPierce` is a hit TAG: it does not double-hit (the engine's PIERCE_CORE_DOUBLE constant is false, so there is no core+body split), and on its own it moves no damage. What it does is make her ELIGIBLE for pierceDamagePct, and her only graded comp seats `mint`, whose S2 grants all allies pierceDamagePct 32.72 for 10s. Measured A/B on that comp: hasPierce on = 444M, ratio 1.100; hasPierce off = 362M, ratio 0.897 — a 22.6% swing, with every other unit in the comp byte-identical. **Do not remove the tag as dead weight, and do not read an inertness result taken in a pierce-free fixture as an inertness result at scope lock.** The encoding is kit-faithful either way; only the reach depends on the comp.
⚑ Her kit gates the Pierce on '>80% HP', which is not encoded. There is no incoming damage at scope lock, so the gate is always satisfied and an ungated tag is exact here. Re-encode the gate if incoming damage is ever modeled.
⚑ S1's Charge Speed is modeled as a flat target-own buff, but the kit says '11.67% of the skill user's Charge Speed' — caster-relative, and no caster-relative charge-speed StatKey exists. OUT-OF-DOMAIN (engine-core primitive). At scope lock alice is at base charge speed unless she ranks top-2 ATK AND her own +80.15% burst buff is live at FB entry, in which case the flat 11.67 understates the grant by up to ~80% of 11.67 (~+9pp), on those rotations only — a low-single-digit-% cadence effect on the 2 targeted allies. Recipe: read the 2 targeted allies' charged-shot cadence in a focus video against the sim; if it disagrees, snapshot the caster's charge speed at FB entry.
UNMODELED: S2's below-80%-HP lifesteal ('continuously recover HP by 8.12% of attack damage'). OUT-OF-DOMAIN and exactly zero impact at scope lock — the boss deals no damage, no unit ever drops below the 80% gate, and there is no HP pool to heal, so the line can move no damage and emits no recovery event.

skill2: ■ Affects self. Activates when HP falls below 80%. Continuously recover HP by 8.12% of attack damage.

caveats: skill2: hasPierce is a hit TAG, not a damage stat — it does not double-hit (the engine's PIERCE_CORE_DOUBLE constant is false), it makes her ELIGIBLE for pierceDamagePct. It is NOT inert on her graded comp: PA MiKa seats mint, whose S2 grants allies pierceDamagePct 32.72/10s, and a measured A/B there moves her 1.100 → 0.897 (444M → 362M, 22.6%) with every other unit in the comp unchanged. An inertness check run in a pierce-free fixture does not generalize to scope lock.

skill2: the Pierce is modeled UNGATED; the kit gates it on '>80% HP', which is always satisfied at scope lock (the boss deals no damage to units). Re-encode the gate if incoming damage is ever modeled.

skill1: Charge Speed 11.67% is modeled as a flat target-own buff; the kit says '11.67% of the skill user's Charge Speed' (caster-relative) and no caster-relative charge-speed StatKey exists. ⚑ OUT-OF-DOMAIN (engine-core primitive). Understates by up to ~+9pp only on rotations where alice is top-2 ATK with her own burst buff live at FB entry — a low-single-digit-% cadence effect on the 2 targeted allies. Recipe: compare the 2 targeted allies' charged-shot cadence in a focus video against the sim.

skill2: the below-80%-HP lifesteal ('recover HP by 8.12% of attack damage') is UNMODELED. ⚑ OUT-OF-DOMAIN (needs an HP pool + incoming-damage model). Exactly 0 impact at scope lock — no unit ever drops below the gate, and there is no HP pool. Recipe: add the HP-pool primitive, then encode the <80% gate, and watch crown's 'when recovery takes effect' consumer in the control comp for leaked ally heals.
